name: sales_report
prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module sales_report
  purpose: Summarize a CSV of sales by region and write the totals to a report file.

import std.console
import std.csv exposing Row
import std.filesystem exposing Path

public type Sale
  purpose: One row of the sales export after cleaning.
  has region: Text
  has product: Text
  has amount: Decimal
end

public type ReportError is one of
  purpose: Why the report could not be produced.
  BadRow(line: Integer, detail: Text)
  Io(detail: Text)
end

function parse_sale(row: Row) returns Sale or fails with ReportError
  let region be row.get("region")
    otherwise fail with BadRow(line: row.line, detail: "missing region")
  let product be row.get("product")
    otherwise fail with BadRow(line: row.line, detail: "missing product")
  let amount_text be row.get("amount")
    otherwise fail with BadRow(line: row.line, detail: "missing amount")
  let amount be amount_text.trim().to_decimal()
    otherwise fail with BadRow(line: row.line, detail: "amount is not a number: {amount_text}")
  return Sale(region: region.trim(), product: product.trim(), amount: amount)
end

public function load_sales(path: Path)
  returns List of Sale
  or fails with ReportError
  needs filesystem.read("data")
  purpose: Read and validate every row of the sales file.

  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with Io(detail: "cannot read {path}")
  let rows be csv.parse(text) otherwise fail with Io(detail: "file is not valid CSV")
  return for each row in rows collect parse_sale(row) otherwise fail
end

public function totals_by_region(sales: List of Sale) returns Map of Text to Decimal
  purpose: Sum of amounts per region.
  example: totals_by_region([]) is {}
  example: totals_by_region([Sale(region: "n", product: "p", amount: 2.5)]) is {"n": 2.5}

  return for each sale in sales group by sale.region sum sale.amount
end

public function main() or fails with ReportError needs console, filesystem("data")
  purpose: Print the regional totals and save them as a CSV report.

  let sales be load_sales(Path("data/sales.csv")) otherwise fail
  let totals be totals_by_region(sales)
  let mutable report be "region,total\n"
  for each region, amount in totals sorted by amount descending
    console.print("{region}: {amount}")
    set report to "{report}{region},{amount}\n"
  end
  filesystem.write_text(path: Path("data/report.csv"), content: report)
    otherwise fail with Io(detail: "cannot write the report")
end
